sources.creator: Vincent Mutwiri (GitHub: Vincent-mutwiri), sole committer; 17 commits, all 2026-05-05. Repo MIT licence names 'Curriculum Data Team' (identity unverified).
sources.licence: Repo licence: MIT (covers 'the Software'). The Markdown files are verbatim conversions of KICD designs and still carry KICD's own 'All rights reserved… without the prior written permission of the publisher' notice (English in 110/133 files; Swahili equivalent in the Kiswahili files).
sources.contentType: Full-text Markdown conversions of KICD curriculum designs (front matter, foreword, strands, outcomes, experiences, rubrics)
sources.grades: G1–G9 broadly complete except PP1/PP2 absent; G10 7/39, G11 8/39, G12 2/39 (see coverage-by-grade.json)
sources.subjects: Most learning areas G4–G9; partial Senior School
sources.framework: CBC (KICD designs, mostly 'Revised 2024'; Senior School 2025 drafts)
sources.machineReadable: Markdown (tables parse). JSON outputs are generated by the author's tool but are NOT committed.
sources.redistribution: No right granted over the KICD content (an MIT notice from a third party cannot license KICD's copyright)
sources.modification: No right granted over the KICD content
sources.commercialUse: No right granted over the KICD content
sources.attribution: MIT requires keeping the notice for the repo's own software only
sources.copyrightConcerns: No statement anywhere in the repo that KICD authorised publication or relicensing; no mention of source; 15 'Lower-Primary-Split' files were derived by the repo author with KICD's notice removed; snapshot dated 2026-05-05 (5 months older than Msingi's KICD register); conversion errors possible (e.g. a Grade 7 table row mis-assigned to 4.0 instead of 5.0).
sources.recommendedUse: Do NOT import. Do NOT redistribute. May be read privately as a cross-check of headings/lesson counts against KICD's own pages (its Grade 7 tables matched Msingi's hand-extracted pilot exactly). Official KICD documents remain the source of record.

sources.contentType: Teaching content: textbook chapters, activities, GeoGebra interactives, STACK exercises (not curriculum structure)
sources.grades: G7, G8, G9, G10, G11 (G12 repo empty)
sources.framework: CBC; README says Grade 7 text created new, aligned to the CBC
